items.t: Beachgoers in Martin County urged to stay out of water after high levels of fecal bacteria found: Officials
items.x: Water samples taken Monday showed unsafe levels of fecal bacteria at 10 locations, including Bathtub Beach and Jensen Beach. Officials say exposure could raise the risk of illness.

items.t: Donalds calls David Jolly a 'fraud' at Stuart rally
items.x: Donalds focused much of his speech on affordability, saying Floridians want to be able to afford insurance and housing, find good-paying jobs and build their lives in the state.

items.t: Martin County man sentenced to 84 years in child pornography, voyeurism case
items.x: Daniel Clark Warren was sentenced to about 84 years in prison after being found guilty on 82 counts, including child pornography and video voyeurism.

items.t: Martin County man charged with attempted murder after roommate slashed in neck with box cutter
items.x: A 32-year-old man is facing an attempted murder charge after deputies say a dispute between roommates ended with a man being slashed in the neck with a box cutter.

items.t: Man accused of slashing acquaintance's neck with box cutter in Martin County
items.x: The Martin County Sheriff's Office have identified the suspect accused of stabbing his acquaintance with a box cutter on Thursday night.

items.t: Judge puts off decision in Comey case as prosecutors pursue new indictment against ex-FBI head
items.x: A federal judge put off a decision Friday on whether to dismiss a placeholder criminal case filed against former FBI Director James Comey, giving the DOJ an opportunity to pursue an indictment over allegations of a decade-old media leak.

items.t: Teen survives fall through pier as king tides batter Florida beaches
items.x: A teenager is recovering after reportedly falling through a Florida pier and being swept away by waves.

items.x: Former Miss America Madison Marsh Morris has given so much to the Arkansas community where she grew up. Now, the community is giving something back to her: a street named in her honor.

items.t: Pahokee and Glades Central renew rivalry in annual Muck Bowl
items.x: The Muck Bowl, a renowned high school football rivalry in Florida, returns tonight as Pahokee and Glades Central face off in a game with a unique scheduling twist this year.

items.t: Man accused of killing 93-year-old in Boca Raton DUI crash faces judge
items.x: Kyrylo Khytrov, charged with DUI manslaughter in a 2024 crash that killed Audrey Milk, has been extradited to the U.S. to face charges.

items.t: Right-wing activists pull voting stunt in Palm Beach County
items.x: Right-wing activists James O’Keefe and Cam Higby attempted voter vouching at the Palm Beach County Supervisor of Elections office, despite the practice being illegal in Florida, according to election officials.

items.t: Woman, 66, charged with 29 counts of animal cruelty after 124 cats removed from Port St. Lucie home
items.x: A 66-year-old woman has been arrested on dozens of animal cruelty charges following an investigation that resulted in 124 cats being removed from a Port St. Lucie home, according to police.
